snp5.12:1.1: NIṬṬHITĀ. Jatukaṇṇimāṇavapucchā (11). "Sutvān' ahaṃ vīram akāmakāmiṃ icc-āyasmā Jakukaṇṇī oghātigaṃ puṭṭhuṃ akāmam āgamaṃ: santipadaṃ brūhi sahājanetta, yathātacchaṃ Bhagavā brūhi me taṃ. || ||
snp5.12:2.1: Bhagavā hi kāme abhibhuyya iriyati ādicco va paṭhaviṃ teji tejasā: parittapaññassa me bhūripañña ācikkha dhammaṃ, yam ahaṃ vijaññaṃ jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ". || ||
snp5.12:3.1: "Kāmesu vinaya gedhaṃ Jatukaṇṇī ti Bhagavā nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato, uggahītaṃ nirattaṃ vā mā te vijjittha kiñcanaṃ. || ||
snp5.12:4.1: Yaṃ pubbe taṃ visosehi, pacchā te māhu kiñcanaṃ, majjhe ce no gahessasi, upasanto carissasi. || ||
snp5.12:5.1: Sabbaso nāmarūpasmiṃ vītagedhassa brāhmaṇa āsavāssa na vijjanti, yehi maccuvasaṃ vaje" ti || || JATUKAṆṆIMĀṆAVAPUCCHĀ
